_comment: DSH MCP descriptor (ADR-0050). DSH's MCP client (dsh-mcp-client) bridges stdio MCP servers into ctx.tools; this descriptor is the de facto reference for the server config. DSH loads the MCP server from the HOST Cordis composition (base.cordis.yml or cordis.patch.yml), not from a standalone file — this file documents the canonical config for manual or installer wiring. Env block is kept in strict lockstep with .mcp.json (scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py). SKILL_SERVER_RECORDS is omitted here deliberately — the engine's Path.home() default resolves the same directory without a machine-pinned literal.
